method: Frobenius norm of (alpha/r)BA divided by base matrix norm; rank products avoid materializing BA
base_loading: Selected local safetensors tensors only; no model construction, torch or GPU
limitations: Weight ratios are descriptive, not proof of why responses did or did not change
The complete base model weight file is not rehashed by this audit
No model generation or geological accuracy is measured
technical_findings: Assistant-only masking, causal label shift and EOS supervision are present; no fatal mask/export error was identified.
LoRA targets are language-only, leaving visual encoder/projector frozen. These text experiments do not train image features.
Previous source-conditioned SFT had 62 optimizer steps; DPO had 36. Their small relative update norms are consistent with weak changes, but do not prove the cause of failed quality checks.
Source facts previously appeared mainly as supplied context; source-conditioned reading and closed-book recall must be evaluated separately.

next_recipe.validation_selection: one fixed final candidate; no validation-selected checkpoint

recommendation_basis: Use expanded source-checked training questions in both closed-book and supplied-context forms; never use rejected false DPO answers as SFT targets.

LR1e-4 is a deliberate stronger single SFT experiment, not a measured Qwen-specific optimum. HF TRL general LoRA guidance lists SFT2e-4 and DPO5e-6; Qwen multimodal documentation has a different lower-rate recipe.
Freeze novel questions before training and retain dialogue/image regressions. Paired context conditions share scenarios and are not independent samples.
Data, target modules and learning rate change together, so an observed gain cannot be attributed to one factor alone.
